CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Spring-2024 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Spring-2024 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 2,925 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 11 benchmark sites in 5 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: September 2024 to November 2024). These surveys captured 18 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 22 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 2,407 cards across 171 sites, with 12.3% showing evidence of mouse activity (297 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 639 transects across 142 sites (survey period: September 2024 to November 2024), detecting active burrows in 3% of transects (total: 22 active burrows).
